question: Should Reef core own and support the Node/PostgreSQL Kubernetes relay, Helm chart, schema migrations, and long-term parity with the Cloudflare adapter?
rationale: The patch can be technically repaired, but adding a second official runtime and persistent backend creates an ongoing product, release, migration, and compatibility commitment that cannot be inferred from tests or contributor intent.

options.title: Own the portable relay
options.body: Approve the Kubernetes/PostgreSQL adapter as an official Reef platform after the proxy-trust defect is fixed and live install/upgrade proof is attached.

options.title: Keep Cloudflare canonical
options.body: Decline the additional core platform and ask that portable deployment work be maintained separately against a narrower supported contract.

recommendation.title: Own the portable relay
recommendation.body: Approve the Kubernetes/PostgreSQL adapter as an official Reef platform after the proxy-trust defect is fixed and live install/upgrade proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository design names Peter as the approver of the current relay architecture, making him the clearest available decision owner for expanding it.
